limitations.note: The two-state rewrite still emits nothing on the third valid byte; the actual fix makes count 2 reachable and selects the second packing branch at that count.
The rewrite also changed the already-correct first output word by taking the second byte’s low nibble instead of preserving its high nibble.
The exhaustive test encoded the rewrite’s low-nibble, one-output-per-pair assumption, so it passed without checking the required second output on the third valid byte.

limitations.quote: The acceptance edge for the second byte will register both outputs.
limitations.note: The agent committed to pairwise behavior without applying the available FSM guide’s transition check, which would have exposed that the existing count-2 output condition was unreachable.
